stories.title: Timeout UX Contract and State Schema
stories.description: Define and normalize frontend state schema for timeout handling including states (pending, timed_out, continued, abandoned), timer threshold (45s), retry intent flag, and modal visibility. Ensure compatibility with existing ChatWindow state and AbortController lifecycle.

stories.title: Core Timeout Detection and Control Logic
stories.description: Implement 45-second timeout detection with safe cleanup, ensuring timers are cleared on response, cancel, or retry. Prevent duplicate in-flight requests and enforce single active request using AbortController.

stories.title: Timeout Modal UI (Continue / Abandon)
stories.description: Render timeout modal with clear user actions: continue waiting (no new request) or abandon (cancel request). Ensure consistent messaging and seamless UX transitions without breaking chat flow.

stories.title: Timeout Handling Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and component tests validating timeout trigger, modal rendering, continue (no duplicate request), and abandon (AbortController invoked). Include edge cases for rapid responses and repeated retries.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing frontend test coverage for ChatWindow timeout behavior; requires new tests

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with Chat Request Lifecycle
stories.description: Integrate timeout handling across full chat lifecycle: message send, streaming/response wait, timeout, user decision, and final resolution. Ensure idempotency, no duplicated backend calls, and correct state recovery after continue/abandon.
